verdict.rationale: Free public document generators or downloadable startup templates are a fair thing to ask of a law firm, so the axis applies. The pack shows only freely readable publications and guides, such as the 2026 Startup Notification analysis. Thought-leadership articles are an adjacent resource, not incorporation forms, SAFEs, term sheets or NDA templates usable without becoming a client, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
